name: Mathematical Obfuscation of Tie-Breaker
description: Replaced the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker with an equivalent algebraic minimization objective (a base-4 polynomial sum). This removes the linguistic trigger that prompts models to use fixed-order numerical backtracking, forcing them to either recognize the mathematical equivalence to lexicographical ordering or attempt to implement a slower, more complex general optimization search which will likely fail or time out.
